header.description: A Magic Shelf auto-updates its book list based on rules you define. Books that match appear automatically — no manual curation needed.

form.namePlaceholder: E.g. Rom-Zom-Coms, Fast & Furious, Missing Metadata
form.publicTooltip: When Public, this shelf is visible to all users on this server

group.conditionTooltip:
AND — book must match ALL rules in this group
OR — book only needs to match ONE rule
group.addRuleTooltip: Add a filter condition (e.g. Read Status = Reading)
group.addGroupTooltip: Add a nested sub-group with its own AND/OR logic — useful for complex queries like (A AND B) OR (C)
group.noRulesHint: No conditions yet — click 'Add Rule' to start filtering books

fieldDescriptions.library: Which library the book belongs to
fieldDescriptions.shelf: Which static shelves the book is on
fieldDescriptions.folderPath: The folder path where the book file is stored
fieldDescriptions.readStatus: Current reading status: Unread, Reading, Read, Paused, etc.
fieldDescriptions.dateFinished: The date you finished reading the book
fieldDescriptions.lastReadTime: The last time you opened this book
fieldDescriptions.metadataScore: Confidence score (0-100) of the metadata match quality
fieldDescriptions.title: The book's title
fieldDescriptions.categories: Genre and category tags assigned to the book
fieldDescriptions.moods: Mood descriptors like Dark, Cozy, Suspenseful, etc.
fieldDescriptions.tags: Your personal tags for organizing books
fieldDescriptions.publishedDate: When the book was originally published
fieldDescriptions.seriesName: Name of the series this book belongs to
fieldDescriptions.seriesNumber: This book's position number within its series
fieldDescriptions.seriesTotal: Total number of books in the series
fieldDescriptions.fileType: File format: EPUB, PDF, CBR, CBZ, etc.
fieldDescriptions.subtitle: The book's subtitle, if any
fieldDescriptions.genre: Genre and category tags assigned to the book
fieldDescriptions.addedOn: When the book was added to your library
fieldDescriptions.description: The book's synopsis or description text
fieldDescriptions.ageRating: Numeric age rating for the book
fieldDescriptions.contentRating: Content rating: Everyone, Teen, Mature, Adult, Explicit
fieldDescriptions.audiobookCodec: Audio codec used for the audiobook
fieldDescriptions.audiobookChapterCount: Number of chapters in the audiobook
fieldDescriptions.isPhysical: Whether this is a physical (paper) book entry
fieldDescriptions.seriesStatus: Overall series reading status: reading, completed, ongoing, etc.
fieldDescriptions.seriesGaps: Detects gaps in series: missing first, missing latest, duplicates
fieldDescriptions.seriesPosition: Position context: first in series, last, or next unread
fieldDescriptions.readingProgress: Your reading progress as a percentage (0-100)
fieldDescriptions.metadataPresence: Check if a specific metadata field is populated or empty

operatorDescriptions.empty: Field has no value (null, empty, or blank)
operatorDescriptions.notEmpty: Field has any value at all
operatorDescriptions.includesAny: Matches if at least one of the selected values is present
operatorDescriptions.excludesAll: Matches only if none of the selected values are present
operatorDescriptions.includesAll: Matches only if all selected values are present
operatorDescriptions.contains: Field text includes the search term anywhere
operatorDescriptions.doesNotContain: Field text does not include the search term
operatorDescriptions.startsWith: Field text begins with the search term
operatorDescriptions.endsWith: Field text ends with the search term
operatorDescriptions.greaterOrEqual: Value is at or above the threshold
operatorDescriptions.lessOrEqual: Value is at or below the threshold
operatorDescriptions.between: Value falls within a range (inclusive). Uses start and end values
operatorDescriptions.withinLast: Date is within the last N days/weeks/months/years
operatorDescriptions.olderThan: Date is older than N days/weeks/months/years ago
operatorDescriptions.thisPeriod: Date falls within the current week, month, or year
operatorDescriptions.isNot: The condition is false / does not match
operatorDescriptions.has: The metadata field is present / populated
operatorDescriptions.hasNot: The metadata field is missing / empty

importJson.buttonTooltip: Paste a previously exported Magic Shelf JSON to restore its rules
importJson.emptyError: Please paste a JSON configuration first.
importJson.parseError: Invalid JSON. Please check the syntax and try again.
importJson.structureError: Invalid structure. The JSON must have "type": "group" and a "rules" array.
importJson.successDetail: Rules imported successfully. Review and save when ready.

toast.validationErrorDetail: You must add at least one valid rule before saving.

templates.browseTooltip: Choose from ready-made shelf templates — no manual rule building needed
templates.noResults: No templates match your search. Try a different term.

matchCount.overCapWarning: Exceeds {{max}} book limit. Refine your rules to avoid truncated results.
